To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the configuration of the quarternay carbon atoms in staffyloferrins and enantio-ferrioxamines is the same, that this configuration is opposite of that in fungal rhizferrins, and that the configuration of staphylococcus siderophores determines their iron transport properties.
the chirality of staphylococcus ferric siderophore is S,S and the chirality of rhizoferrins from Aspergillus fumigatus is R,R.
staphylococcus bacteria use the same siderophore for iron uptake as the fungi, but with a different configuration, and that this configuration is crucial for the uptake of the siderophores.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the configuration of chiral carbon atoms and the transport properties of staphylococcus siderophores in staphylococcia.
the elucidation of the structure and the transport properties of siderophores.
the elucidation of the structure of the iron-transporter staphylo ferrin A and with the analysis of its function in iron uptake in staphylococcus.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the chirality of a carboxylate is a determinant of its biological function, and thus of its biological origin.
the bacterial siderophores staphylo- ferrin A and enantiomer-rhizoferin have the same chirality, while the fungal siderophore rhizoferrins have the opposite chirality.
the chirality of citryl moieties in bacterial siderophores is S,S, while in fungal siderophores the chirality is R,R.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the bacterial siderophores have a common S,S-configuration while the fungal siderophores are R,R-structured.
bacterial iron uptake systems are more flexible than those of fungi.
the chirality of a bacterial siderophore is determined by the biosynthetic pathway and that the chirality has a profound effect on its biological activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the chirality of citryl groups in staphylococcin and rhizoferrins are different, and that these differences are reflected in the iron uptake properties in the respective organisms.
the chirality of staphylococcic siderophores is essential for iron uptake.
the chirality of staphylococcus siderophore is important for its biological activity.
